tei:bibl.tei:title: הֶן־עָם לְבָדָד יִשְׁכֹּן
"A People That Dwells Apart" — a ritual after withdrawing from those who left us alone, by Rabbi Dr. Andrea Zanardo
tei:bibl.tei:author: Andrea Zanardo
tei:bibl.tei:note: Converted from the export of opensiddur.org at 624215eef0.

tei:div.tei:p: I wrote this ritual in 2026 for Jews who have felt compelled to withdraw from friendships, organisations, or social and religious environments in which antisemitism, hostility towards Israel, or the dismissal of Jewish grief had become tolerated or normalised. It is intended particularly for those who have already established a practical boundary—by leaving, blocking, unfollowing, or ending a relationship—and who need a Jewish ritual through which to acknowledge the resulting grief and affirm their dignity, solidarity, and continued connection to the Jewish people.
